observations.code_quote: Note: Deliberately scoped: the connector takes a single user-supplied dataset_id and syncs GET /v2/datasets/{id}/items into one user-named table, so it can cover any dataset but only one per configured source. It is not dynamic discovery - get_schemas returns a static endpoint catalog. The account-level tables alongside it (runs, actors, datasets, monthly usage) are addressed by the API token alone and cover the operational and cost side of the platform.
